name: Tomas
label: Album-focused decade-long subscriber, UI-frustrated
who: I've had Spotify for about a decade, sometimes on the free tier and sometimes on paid. I listen album by album and like songs individually, and I care most about being able to see which tracks I've already liked.
value_for_money: Mixed. I say ads are tolerable on the free tier when skipping works, and I think paying for a feature that only shows listening counts isn't worth it. My complaints are about features rather than price.
loyalty: A decade of subscriptions, Daily Mix, and my liked songs keep me here. I say I'd move to another app if the liked-song changes stay, and I'd unsubscribe again if the hearts don't come back.
pain_points: Liked-song hearts no longer show on album or track lists
Can't see an artist's full song library or play it in order
The side panel pops up while I browse new artists
Artists from liked songs don't appear in my artist tab
likes: Liking single songs instead of whole albums
Daily Mix playlist built from years of my input
Discovery features that have led me to songs I end up liking
Downloads and offline mode for quicker loading
reasons_to_stay: I stay for the Daily Mix, my liked songs history, and discovery features that still turn up songs I end up liking. Apple Music is the alternative I keep weighing, but the main thing keeping me from switching is a feature I miss in the current app.
tone: Sardonic and detailed, with frustrated sentences that trail into specific UI complaints.
